headline: Recommendation on Waring School site plan at 38 Standley Street, plus pedestrian and traffic safety concerns at several intersections.
summary: The agenda includes an open space residential design site plan review for Waring School's Standley Street property. It also lists a request to review parking and traffic on Essex and Cole streets, which is to be continued over multiple meetings.

Order #258-2026, review of parking and traffic along Essex Street and Cole Street, submitted by Councillor-at-Large Matthew St. Hilaire
